faqs.a: Yes. Relay.app's homepage says it has shut down and that all accounts, workflows and run history were permanently deleted.

faqs.q: Can I get my Relay workflows back?
faqs.a: No. The data has been deleted, so each workflow has to be rebuilt from your notes.

faqs.q: Which alternative is closest to Relay.app?
faqs.a: Look for approval steps. Zapier has Human in the Loop on Professional and up, and 50agents asks before any email reaches a client.

faqs.q: Which alternative is free to start?
faqs.a: 50agents is free to start. Activepieces has a Free plan with 1,000 credits and unlimited flows, and Make has 1,000 credits a month.

faqs.q: Can I rebuild my workflows in 50agents?
faqs.a: Yes, by description. Tell Captain what each workflow did, and it shows a plan before it builds.
n8n and Activepieces both run on your own servers.

faqs.q: How many apps do the alternatives connect?
faqs.a: Zapier connects 10,541+ apps and Make 3,500+. n8n lists 2,829 integrations, and Activepieces has 770+. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps.
